item.title: Domestic abuse protection orders will be rolled out from tomorrow
item.body: Domestic Abuse Protection Notices and Domestic Abuse Protection Orders will be rolled out across England and Wales starting tomorrow. They are described as the strongest ever protections for domestic abuse victims.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚖️ Domestic abuse protection orders will be rolled out from tomorrow

Domestic Abuse Protection Notices and Domestic Abuse Protection Orders will be rolled out across England and Wales starting tomorrow. They are described as the strongest ever protections for domestic abuse victims.

Source: GOV.UK Home Office | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 12:20

#BreakingNews #DomesticAbuse #LawChange
